Name: SharedAll -Official-
Author: BoogaJoker
Description:
[size=5]SharedAll is a Stardew Valley co-op sharing mod that brings many multiplayer progress-sharing features into one configurable mod.
It helps co-op farms feel more shared by syncing progress between players, including XP, recipes, collections, powers, special unlocks, currencies, relationships, quests "[/size][size=4]to make it more fair only one player can accept the reward"[/size][size=5], monster kills, cutscenes, and more.
No need for extra cabins, if you want to sleep in the same roof to save your farming space.
It also adds extra co-op tools like shared dungeon health, cutscene time pause, and expandable greenhouse upgrades.
Most features can be toggled in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu, so each farm can choose what should be shared.

Main features:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Shared XP[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shared All Recipes[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shared All Collections[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shared Currency[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shared relationships, gift logs, professions, quests, and special orders[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shared Overall kills for every quest and others[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shared cutscenes with automatic pause[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Manual multiplayer pause hotkey if the feel is needed for a pause[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Optional dungeon shared health mode for a bit of spicy[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Greenhouse upgrade system with larger greenhouse layouts[/size]
[size=4](Soon another room will be attached to the green house called Zen place)[/size][/*]
